name: TEUCRIUM MARUM VERUM
key_symptoms: Vomiting of large quantities of dark-green masses. Constant hiccough, attended with pain in back. Unnatural appetite. Hiccough on eating, after nursing.
Excited, tremulous feeling. Frontal pain; worse, stooping. Strengthens brain after delirium tremens.
Dry cough, tickling in trachea; moldy taste in throat when hawking up mucus, expectoration profuse.
Affection of finger-tips and joints of toes. Tearing pains in arms and legs. Pain in toe-nails, as if they had grown into flesh.
